newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Kaikai to list B shares next Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Kaikai to list B shares next Wednesday.

text.p: Clothes maker Shanghai Kaikai Industrial Co Ltd will list 80 million foreign currency B share on the Shanghai stock exchange next Wednesday, January 8, a company statement said on Saturday.

The shares were issued last month at $0.256 per share, raising $19.15 million excluding the issue cost, the statement said. Proceeds would be used to expand the firm's clothing production and to open new sales outlets around China.
The B shares account for 40.4 percent of the company's total outstanding 198 million shares, the statement said.

The state owns 71.74 million, or 36.23 percent, of the outstanding shares, institutions own 31.26 million, or 15.79 percent, and staff the remaining 15 million shares, or 7.58 percent, the statement said.
It said the company's post-tax profit was 33 million yuan for 1995 against 22.7 million yuan for 1994. It gave no figures for 1996 or earnings per share.
